recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up, high-contrast portrait of a man with an intense, snarling expression, focusing on the eyes and mouth to reveal gold-capped teeth. The lighting is harsh, emphasizing skin texture and facial contours, with a centered typographic block and a secondary vertical text element on the left margin.
coreVisualRelationships: Text centered over the bridge of the nose
Gold teeth as the primary focal point of the lower half
Intense eye contact framing the upper text block
Vertical margin text contrasting with horizontal central text
coreInvariants: Extreme macro crop of the face
Visible skin pores and sweat texture
High-shine metallic gold teeth with specular highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 100% of the frame, cropped at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The mouth with gold teeth acts as the heavy visual anchor at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes lead down to the central title, then drop to the shimmering gold teeth, finally scanning the vertical margin text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with facial features.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm brown skin tones with deep shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Reflective gold for the teeth and a saturated red for the margin/sticker elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark shadows of the face and the bright white text/gold highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Square-cut serifs on the display face
Uniform stroke weight for the vertical margin text
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; focus is on impact through scale and weight.

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a red vertical bar

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for the main title paired with a condensed sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Rectangular red 'hype sticker' in the bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif aesthetic and blunt terminals.
Suitable for the condensed vertical margin text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a hyper-realistic extreme close-up of a man's face with a snarling expression, showing intense eyes and an open mouth with shiny gold-capped teeth. The lighting should be harsh and dramatic, emphasizing skin texture and sweat. The crop should be tight on the features.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-line centered title in a heavy white slab-serif font over the middle of the face. Add a vertical red bar on the far left with white condensed sans-serif text rotated 270 degrees. Place a small red rectangular box in the bottom right corner with small white sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the skin texture highly detailed?
Are the gold teeth reflective and prominent?
Is the central text a heavy slab serif?
Is there a red vertical element on the left?

adjustableVariables: Amount of gold on the teeth
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold teeth have realistic specular highlights.
Verify the text is perfectly centered horizontally.
Check that the red margin bar does not obscure the eyes.
Confirm the skin tones are rich and saturated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme Close-up Portrait + Heavy Slab Serif + Metallic Accents + High Contrast Lighting
